description: This Java source file defines a custom test execution listener for JUnit tests in the OpenMRS project, specifically used to start and manage modules during testing. It extends AbstractTestExecutionListener and handles module startup, context refresh, and cleanup based on annotations on test classes.

classes.name: StartModuleExecutionListener
classes.description: A test execution listener class that manages module lifecycle during testing by starting specified modules, refreshing the application context, and cleaning up.

methods.name: prepareTestInstance
methods.description: Prepares the test instance by starting modules specified via the @StartModule annotation and reloading the application context accordingly.

methods.name: removeFilteredBeanDefinitions
methods.description: Removes bean definitions related to specific profiles from the application context before starting modules.

methods.name: afterTestClass
methods.description: Cleans up after test class execution by shutting down modules and restoring removed bean definitions.
